network.name: TC-S Network
network.description: The Current-See hosts the TC-S Network—an AI-guided commissioning and marketplace platform using Solar currency, stewarded by the TC-S Foundation. Use cases include Global Basic Income Networks, private network deployments (venues, cities, enterprises), and energy-based valuation, pricing, and distribution—wrapped in an AI energetic + ethical decision layer for real-world trade and governance.
